scope: Reference lifecycle test seed/readiness ordering diagnosis, NOT a backend repair or gate signoff
finding: The live control received the genuine target INSERT seeded before channel startup. The UPDATE-only cycle channel received its expected UPDATE, but the wildcard control queue still held the seed INSERT. CDC SUBSCRIBED was incorrectly treated as a commit-time cutoff for already pending seed changes.
correction: Establish CDC-ready live control before seeding, explicitly consume and validate both target/control INSERTs, then run 100 UPDATE/leave/post-leave barriers. Apply the same readiness-first ordering in browsers. Do not ignore/filter queued events, add sleeps, invent a cutoff, or weaken payload/postcondition/cleanup assertions.
limitations: One local diagnostic; not a general historical replay, exactly-once or reconnect guarantee. Initial 4-pass/1-fail and diagnostic 4-pass/1-fail reports remain unchanged; revised tests have not run. No raw IDs, row contents or credentials published.
